text: Priya (PM): From the design review: console uses 'Variant' in the models table, docs and glossary use 'Version'. Testers got mixed signals and support tickets reference 'pinning a variant'. Alex (Design): We abbreviated to 'Variant' to fit the table, but agree we need consistency. Suggest visible label 'Version' and a tiny inline link 'How to pin' that targets the pinning H2 in docs. Noemi (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'model version'. I can add alias before the H2 and a short header note: "Console label: Version (historically Variant)". Also add search synonyms for variant/tag. Tariq (Eng): Implementation notes: fragments are client-side so Noemi's hidden anchor is right. We'll keep telemetry event model_variant_click to avoid dashboard churn and map label text at UI layer. I'll add aria-labels and an e2e to assert focus lands on the H2 after the link. Alex (Design): Accessibility: inline link should read 'How to pin a model version' for screen readers. Tooltips must be keyboard-focusable and referenced by aria-describedby. Avoid ellipses in narrow widths. Priya (PM): Timeline: get docs PR today, UI small change in next patch. Noemi/Tariq coordinate on anchor placement and tests. ConsoleBot: checklist: docs-pr: pending, ui-branch: open, qa-ticket: QA-7007. Noemi (Docs): Will open PR and add glossary cross-link at top of the in-product panel. Will ping when ready. Tariq (Eng): I'll include the analytics mapping in the PR and add the e2e. Landing once docs merged. Priya (PM): Thanks everyone. Reconvene if any redirects/anchors cause regressions.
